'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[:Category:Drops|Drop]] item obtained from fishing in the [[Parasite Biome]] and infected Bears.

== ''Obtainment'' ==
*Fishing in the [[Parasite Biome]] (needs verification).
*Dropped by [[Assimilated Bear|Assimilated]], [[Assimara Bear|Assimara]], and [[Feral Bear|Feral Bears]].

== ''Usage'' ==
It can be eaten, but deals 8 ([[File:Heart.png]][[File:Heart.png]][[File:Heart.png]][[File:Heart.png]]) damage to the player and inflicts [[Call Of The Hive]] for 4 minutes.

== Trivia ==
* The name appears to be a pun of fish and [[Buglin]], possibly a Buglin variant that evolved to an aquatic environment, though it does not have a mob form as of the current version.
